title: MongoDB Company Values Storyboard Campaign
summary: A storyboarded launch campaign using original illustration and presentation design to introduce MongoDB's company values.
overview: I developed a storyboarded presentation campaign to introduce MongoDB's company values. A recurring cast of illustrated characters moved through scenes tied to values such as Build Together, Be Intellectually Honest, and Own What You Do.

projectBrief.context: MongoDB needed to introduce its company values through a presentation-led internal campaign.
projectBrief.challenge: The values were abstract ideas that needed a memorable narrative rather than a sequence of text-only slides.
projectBrief.contribution: I developed the storyboard, original illustration direction, presentation design, and supporting communications.
projectBrief.approach: I created a recurring cast of characters and placed them in scenes that made each value visible through action, exploration, and reflection.
projectBrief.outcome: The work delivered a connected narrative campaign for launching the values across presentation and communications materials.
